notes.title: Copa Petrobras de Marcas v1.10 RELEASED - now available on Steam!

tags.feature: Added UI option for race start time (including night racing!)
Added option to turn off qualifying and manually set starting position;
Support for adjusting graphical steering wheel range in-game from the Controller menu (min 180º max 900º);

tags.balance_change: Minimum vertical FOV setting adjusted from 35º to 10º;

tags.feature: Updated Tarumã track to the latest specification
